title: Synthesis and in vitro antitumor evaluation of novel 3,4-dihydropyrimidinone-vorinostat hybrids against gastric and breast cancer cell lines
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14027-14035
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00701E, Paper

E. A. M. Rios, G. M. S. D. M. Pereira, M. G. M. D'Oca, C. M. Dea, E. R. F. B. Santos, D. S. Rampon, L. S. Santos, F. M. Nachtigall, L. Guzman, R. Moore-Carrasco, D. Rebolledo-Miraf, C. R. M. D'Oca
Novel DHPM–SAHA hybrids bearing a hydroxamic acid terminal group, inspired by Vorinostat, were synthesized via the Biginelli reaction and evaluated for in vitro antitumour activity against AGS (gastric) and MCF-7 (breast) cancer cell lines.
